spells.name: Cull the Meek
spells.description: Renekton swings his blade, dealing physical damage and restoring Health per non-champion and per champion hit. He also generates Fury per non-champion and Fury per champion. Fury Bonus: Damage is increased to physical damage and healing is increased to Health against non-champions and Health against champions. Does not generate any Fury.
